display_long_description:
1 ) After putting on the dustproof suit, cap, and shoes, wash and dry your hands, enter the air wash room, and wear gloves.
2 ) Sort the dustproof shoes, cap, and suit, then place them into boxes.
3 ) Separate the dustproof suits into regular wash, sterilization wash, and disposal, then place them into boxes.
4 ) Separate the dustproof shoes into regular wash, sterilization wash, and disposal, then place them into boxes.
5 ) Put the laundry from the basket into the washing machine.
6 ) Close the washing machine door, select either regular or sterilization wash by pressing the appropriate button, then press Start.
7 ) Open the washing machine door, remove the cleaned dustproof suits, and place them in the basket.
8 ) Check each dustproof suit and separate any defective ones into a different basket.
9 ) Check the sizes of the tops and bottoms, and place one set of matching sizes into each plastic bag.
10 ) Place the opening of the plastic bag into the vacuum sealer and press the button.
11 ) Put the packaged dustproof suits onto the shelf next to you.
12 ) Emergency situation: If the plastic bag is torn, remove the suit and repackage it with a new plastic bag before continuing.
